title: Picture your best SF tour ever! (Epic Bay Area photo adventures)
includes: Expert custom-tailored guiding from a lifelong local hiker, mountain biker, and photographer.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
If you have a wheelchair or stroller, we can put it in the back of my SUV and we can focus on accessible areas. Service animals are welcome, but might limit our access to certain areas.
policies: If you have any health concerns such as those listed here, we can ease back on the physical activities to whatever you feel is safe and appropriate for you.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
THIS IS THE OPPOSITE OF A PACKAGED TOUR. It's a private, customized journey through our most unique and iconic scenery. Along the way, I'll show you how to get great photos you can share and frame. 

* * * DON'T HAVE A FULL DAY? You can book the 4-HOUR OPTION and still see tons of amazing stuff! ***

This is for people who want to see what really makes San Francisco the most spectacular city in the world — its natural surroundings! 

We can hike, bike, trail run, or even just drive to awesome places if you're not feeling energetic. Along the way, I'll show you how to take killer pictures using just the phone in your pocket. 

I'll create our itinerary based on your interests, how active you want to get, and what the weather's doing that day. 

In the winter, we can see waterfalls in misty redwood forests. In the spring, green hills full of wildflowers. In the summer, fog rolling in off the ocean. And in the fall, incandescent sunsets over crashing waves. It's awesome all year round!
